lh AS (SELECT l.linha, h.uf, h.hospital,
         count(DISTINCT s.id_exame) AS laudos_30d,
         count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.fl_relevante = 1 THEN s.id_exame END) AS relevantes_30d
       FROM (SELECT * FROM VALUES ('ateromatose_coronariana'), ('cancer_colon'), ('cancer_estomago'), ('cancer_rim'), ('doenca_inflamatoria_intestinal'), ('doencas_biliares'), ('hepatologia'), ('neuroimunologia'), ('pirads'), ('reumatologia'), ('tirads'), ('transplante_pulmao'), ('tumor_osseo') AS t(linha)) l
       CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT uf, hospital FROM hm) h
       JOIN hm ON hm.hospital = h.hospital
       LEFT JOIN s ON s.linha = l.linha AND s.unidade = hm.unidade
       GROUP BY 1, 2, 3),
ult AS (SELECT 'ateromatose_coronariana' AS linha, max(CAST(dt_execucao_modelo AS DATE)) AS ultima FROM diamond_fabrica_ia.ateromatose_coronariana.tb_mod_diamond_ateromatose_coronariana_saida_v0 UNION ALL SELECT 'cancer_colon' AS linha, max(CAST(dt_execucao_modelo AS DATE)) AS ultima FROM diamond_fabrica_ia.cancer_colon.tb_mod_diamond_cancer_colon_saida_v0 UNION ALL SELECT 'cancer_estomago' AS linha, max(CAST(dt_execucao_modelo AS DATE)) AS ultima FROM diamond_fabrica_ia.cancer_estomago.tb_mod_diamond_cancer_estomago_saida_v0 UNION ALL SELECT 'cancer_rim' AS linha, max(CAST(dt_execucao_modelo AS DATE)) AS ultima FROM diamond_fabrica_ia.cancer_rim.tb_mod_diamond_cancer_rim_saida_v0 UNION ALL SELECT 'doenca_inflamatoria_intestinal' AS linha, max(CAST(dt_execucao_modelo AS DATE)) AS ultima FROM diamond_fabrica_ia.doenca_inflamatoria_intestinal.tb_mod_diamond_doenca_inflamatoria_intestinal_saida_v0 UNION ALL SELECT 'doencas_biliares' AS linha, max(CAST(dt_execucao_modelo AS DATE)) AS ultima FROM diamond_fabrica_ia.doencas_biliares.tb_mod_diamond_doencas_biliares_saida_v0 UNION ALL SELECT 'hepatologia' AS linha, max(CAST(dt_execucao_modelo AS DATE)) AS ultima FROM diamond_fabrica_ia.hepatologia.tb_mod_diamond_hepatologia_saida_v0 UNION ALL SELECT 'neuroimunologia' AS linha, max(CAST(dt_execucao_modelo AS DATE)) AS ultima FROM diamond_fabrica_ia.neuroimunologia.tb_mod_diamond_neuroimunologia_saida_v0 UNION ALL SELECT 'pirads' AS linha, max(CAST(dt_execucao_modelo AS DATE)) AS ultima FROM diamond_fabrica_ia.pirads.tb_mod_diamond_pirads_saida_v0 UNION ALL SELECT 'reumatologia' AS linha, max(CAST(dt_execucao_modelo AS DATE)) AS ultima FROM diamond_fabrica_ia.reumatologia.tb_mod_diamond_reumatologia_saida_v0 UNION ALL SELECT 'tirads' AS linha, max(CAST(dt_execucao_modelo AS DATE)) AS ultima FROM diamond_fabrica_ia.tirads.tb_mod_diamond_tirads_saida_v0 UNION ALL SELECT 'transplante_pulmao' AS linha, max(CAST(dt_execucao_modelo AS DATE)) AS ultima FROM diamond_fabrica_ia.transplante_pulmao.tb_mod_diamond_transplante_pulmao_saida_v0 UNION ALL SELECT 'tumor_osseo' AS linha, max(CAST(dt_execucao_modelo AS DATE)) AS ultima FROM diamond_fabrica_ia.tumor_osseo.tb_mod_diamond_tumor_osseo_saida_v0)
SELECT CASE lh.linha WHEN 'ateromatose_coronariana' THEN 'Ateromatose' WHEN 'cancer_colon' THEN 'Ca de Cólon' WHEN 'cancer_estomago' THEN 'Ca de Estômago' WHEN 'cancer_rim' THEN 'Ca de Rim' WHEN 'doenca_inflamatoria_intestinal' THEN 'DII' WHEN 'doencas_biliares' THEN 'Doenças biliares' WHEN 'hepatologia' THEN 'Hepatologia' WHEN 'neuroimunologia' THEN 'Neuroimunologia' WHEN 'pirads' THEN 'Próstata (PI-RADS)' WHEN 'reumatologia' THEN 'Reumatologia' WHEN 'tirads' THEN 'Tireoide (TI-RADS)' WHEN 'transplante_pulmao' THEN 'Transplante de pulmão' WHEN 'tumor_osseo' THEN 'Tumor ósseo' END AS linha, count(*) AS hospitais,
  sum(CASE WHEN laudos_30d = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sem_laudo,
  sum(CASE WHEN laudos_30d BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ate_30,
  percentile_approx(laudos_30d, 0.5) AS mediana_laudos,
  sum(laudos_30d) AS laudos_30d, sum(relevantes_30d) AS relevantes_30d,
  date_format(max(u.ultima), 'dd/MM/yyyy') AS ultima_execucao,
  CASE WHEN max(u.ultima) < date_sub(current_date(), 3) THEN '🔴 sem execução recente' ELSE '🟢 rodando' END AS execucao
FROM lh JOIN ult u ON u.linha = lh.linha
GROUP BY lh.linha ORDER BY laudos_30d DESC

WITH seg AS (SELECT * FROM VALUES ('tirads', DATE'2026-10-30'), ('reumatologia', DATE'2026-10-30'), ('doenca_inflamatoria_intestinal', DATE'2026-11-05'), ('ateromatose_coronariana', DATE'2026-11-05'), ('doencas_biliares', DATE'2026-11-12'), ('neuroimunologia', DATE'2026-11-12') AS t(esp, dt_segregacao)),
rel AS (SELECT nm_especialidade AS esp, to_date(dt_execucao_modelo) AS dia, max_by(qt_exportados, dh_registro) AS exportados,
          max_by(qt_controle, dh_registro) AS controle, max_by(qt_intervencao, dh_registro) AS intervencao,
          max_by(qt_sem_chave, dh_registro) AS sem_chave, max(CASE WHEN st_execucao = 'SUCESSO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS teve_sucesso,
          max_by(st_execucao, dh_registro) AS ultimo_status
        FROM mlops_fabrica_ia.operacao.tb_mov_randomizacao_relatorio WHERE tp_ambiente = 'prd' AND nm_especialidade IN ('tirads', 'reumatologia', 'doenca_inflamatoria_intestinal', 'ateromatose_coronariana', 'doencas_biliares', 'neuroimunologia')
          AND to_date(dt_execucao_modelo) >= DATE'2026-10-12' GROUP BY 1, 2),
env AS (SELECT specialty AS esp, dt_execucao_modelo AS dia, exame_an FROM mlops_fabrica_ia.operacao.tb_mov_onedrive_saida
        WHERE environment = 'prd' AND specialty IN ('tirads', 'reumatologia', 'doenca_inflamatoria_intestinal', 'ateromatose_coronariana', 'doencas_biliares', 'neuroimunologia') GROUP BY 1, 2, 3),
itv AS (SELECT nm_especialidade AS esp, to_date(dt_execucao_modelo) AS dia, exame_an FROM mlops_fabrica_ia.operacao.tb_mov_randomizacao_intervencao
        WHERE tp_ambiente = 'prd' AND nm_especialidade IN ('tirads', 'reumatologia', 'doenca_inflamatoria_intestinal', 'ateromatose_coronariana', 'doencas_biliares', 'neuroimunologia') GROUP BY 1, 2, 3),
cruz AS (SELECT coalesce(e.esp, i.esp) AS esp, coalesce(e.dia, i.dia) AS dia, count(DISTINCT e.exame_an) AS enviados,
           count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.exame_an IS NOT NULL AND i.exame_an IS NOT NULL THEN e.exame_an END) AS enviados_da_intervencao,
           count(DISTINCT i.exame_an) AS exames_intervencao
         FROM env e FULL OUTER JOIN itv i ON i.esp = e.esp AND i.dia = e.dia AND i.exame_an = e.exame_an GROUP BY 1, 2),
d AS (SELECT r.esp, r.dia, s.dt_segregacao,
        CASE WHEN s.dt_segregacao IS NULL THEN 'aguardando' WHEN r.dia >= s.dt_segregacao THEN 'segregado' ELSE 'antes' END AS fase,
        CASE WHEN r.teve_sucesso = 1 THEN 'SUCESSO' ELSE coalesce(r.ultimo_status, '—') END AS execucao,
        coalesce(r.exportados, 0) AS exportados, coalesce(r.controle, 0) AS controle, coalesce(r.intervencao, 0) AS intervencao,
        coalesce(c.enviados, 0) AS enviados, coalesce(c.enviados - c.enviados_da_intervencao, 0) AS enviados_fora_intervencao,
        coalesce(c.exames_intervencao - c.enviados_da_intervencao, 0) AS intervencao_nao_enviada, coalesce(r.sem_chave, 0) AS sem_chave
      FROM rel r JOIN seg s ON s.esp = r.esp LEFT JOIN cruz c ON c.esp = r.esp AND c.dia = r.dia),
ult AS (SELECT esp, max(CASE WHEN execucao = 'SUCESSO' THEN dia END) AS ultimo_sucesso, max(dia) AS ultimo_dia FROM d GROUP BY 1)
SELECT CASE s.esp WHEN 'tirads' THEN 'Tireoide' WHEN 'reumatologia' THEN 'Reumatologia' WHEN 'doenca_inflamatoria_intestinal' THEN 'DII' WHEN 'ateromatose_coronariana' THEN 'Ateromatose' WHEN 'doencas_biliares' THEN 'Doenças biliares' WHEN 'neuroimunologia' THEN 'Neuroimunologia' END AS linha,
  CASE WHEN s.dt_segregacao IS NULL THEN '⏳ aguardando' ELSE concat('✅ desde ', date_format(s.dt_segregacao, 'dd/MM')) END AS segregacao,
  sum(CASE WHEN d.fase = 'segregado' THEN d.controle + d.intervencao ELSE 0 END) AS sorteados,
  sum(CASE WHEN d.fase = 'segregado' THEN d.controle ELSE 0 END) AS controle,
  round(100 * sum(CASE WHEN d.fase = 'segregado' THEN d.controle ELSE 0 END) / nullif(sum(CASE WHEN d.fase = 'segregado' THEN d.controle + d.intervencao ELSE 0 END), 0), 1) AS pct_controle,
  sum(CASE WHEN d.fase = 'segregado' THEN d.enviados_fora_intervencao ELSE 0 END) AS enviados_fora_intervencao,
  sum(CASE WHEN d.fase = 'segregado' THEN d.intervencao_nao_enviada ELSE 0 END) AS intervencao_nao_enviada,
  date_format(u.ultimo_sucesso, 'dd/MM') AS ultima_execucao_ok,
  CASE WHEN s.dt_segregacao IS NULL THEN '⏳ ligar a segregação'
       WHEN sum(CASE WHEN d.fase = 'segregado' THEN d.enviados_fora_intervencao ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '🔴 controle pode ter sido enviado'
       WHEN u.ultimo_dia > u.ultimo_sucesso THEN '🟡 última execução sem sucesso'
       ELSE '🟢 ok' END AS situacao
FROM seg s JOIN d ON d.esp = s.esp JOIN ult u ON u.esp = s.esp
GROUP BY s.esp, s.dt_segregacao, u.ultimo_sucesso, u.ultimo_dia
ORDER BY s.dt_segregacao NULLS LAST, linha
